newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures finish down, specs liquidate longs.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures finish down, specs liquidate longs.

text.p: Frozen concentrated orange juice futures settled lower as speculators liquidated long positions amid a dearth of trade buying, floor sources said.
"We are starting to see the beginnings of speculative long liquidation on the heels of the market's inability to do any technical movement yesterday," a trader said.
He said that the spot-May contract tried but failed on Tuesday to move over 86.00 cents, where technical signals would have prompted additional buying.

But the failure to pierce the key level prompted selling from today's open, and the close near the lows sets the stage for additional weakness Thursday, when May could test support at 80.00 cents, dealers said.
A weekly movement figure below 5 million gallons in tomorrow's report, released after the close, would put additional pressure on the market.
Analysts do not expect huge losses ahead of the long Easter weekend, however.
The May contract closed at 81.80 cents, down 1.55, having ranged from 82.95 to 81.70 cents. The back months settled 1.25 to 0.25 weaker.
Volume was estimated at 3,000 lots compared to Tuesday's official 1,796 lots.
